q1_find.question: How many AI subscription seats were purchased but not active in August 2026, and what do they cost per month?
q1_find.answer: 67 of 157 AI seats were not active in August 2026, costing CHF 1,223.51 per month (USD → CHF at 0.8076, the August 2026 ECB average).
sources: ai_subscriptions.csv (contract_status = Final; Draft rows next to Final versions dropped)
q1_find.calc: inactive = licences_purchased − licences_active_30d; cost = inactive × price_per_seat (USD) × usd_chf of the month
q1_find.note: Draft rows for the same month and cost center ignored (0 kept as Draft-only: none expected).

q2_decide.question: What does it bring to start the GPU server only when needed? State the effort and the savings in CHF and CO2 (location-based) per year.
q2_decide.answer: Today gpu-ml-01 (Frankfurt) runs 168 of 168 h a week at 9.2 % average GPU utilisation. Measure M-04 «Use GPU only on demand»: effort 1.5 person-days (CHF 1,650); savings per year 9,471 CHF (range 9,457–9,483), 757 kWh (range 485–1,305) and 274.7 kg CO2 (range 159.9–561.0) location-based. Status: ok (decides: Head of Consulting).
q2_decide.calc: savings = recurring baseline of each scope × shares chosen by the advisor; CO2 of relocated load × (1 − grid target / grid origin). res:gpu-ml: cost × 0.83, energy × 0.65

assumptions.label: Energy per GPU-hour (300-W class at 10 % GPU, incl. host)
assumptions.source: data_dictionary.md (300-W class GPU); idle 10–30 % of TDP is an assumption for data-centre GPUs.

assumptions.label: Germany (Frankfurt): national electricity mix
assumptions.source: Umweltbundesamt, «Entwicklung der spezifischen Treibhausgas-Emissionen des deutschen Strommix 1990–2024» (Climate Change 13/2025) and UBA topic page «CO2-Emissionen pro Kilowattstunde Strom 2024»: 363 g CO2/kWh in 2024 (estimate), 386 g in 2023. Retrieved 2026-11-21.

q3_limits.question: May the production platform be switched off at night and at weekends?
q3_limits.answer: Not as a general rule, and not without a decision. Nights: fixed jobs need the platform every day («Nightly ETL» starts 02:00 (median 1.5 h), must be done by 06:00; «PBI refresh large» starts 05:30 (median 1.2 h), must be done by 07:30), and finance closing needs it on the last 3 working days until 04:00 (T-1029). Weekends: 1.5 active h/day and 41.1 queries/day (working days: 10.33 h, 1952.6 queries), so mostly idle but not unused. A narrower switch-off outside these windows can be assessed; the Head of Consulting decides before anything changes.
